aiOverview.content: Several schools and2-1/2 hours early on Monday, March 16, 2026, due to weather. Major districts like Culpeper County are closed, while Prince William County is on a Code Orange, operating with remote learning. Closings are also affecting areas in Maryland and Virginia. Key Closings & Delays (March 16, 2026) Culpeper County Public Schools: Closed. Fairfax County Public Schools: Closing 3 hours early. Prince William County Public Schools: Code Orange (Remote Learning). Ivymount & Maddux Schools: Closing 2-1/2 hours early. The River School: Closing 1:00 PM. Grant County Schools (WV): 3-hour delay. Hardy County Schools (WV): 3-hour delay. Highland County Schools (VA): 2-hour delay. Colleges Closed/Remote: Christopher Newport University, College of the Albemarle, Hampton University, Paul D. Camp Community College, Virginia Peninsula Community College, William & Mary. For the most up-to-date information, check: NBC4 Washington's closing page WTOP's closures list Local TV/radio stations
